claims.statement: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is (as of the September 2024 article) Director-General of the World Health Organization.

fact.value: Director-General of the World Health Organization

citations.quote: Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is director-general of the World Health Organization.

claims.statement: Tedros's current employer is the World Health Organization.

citations.quote: As director-general of the World Health Organization, I see this declaration as a strong signal from countries that they are committed to addressing this global threat.
Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is director-general of the World Health Organization.

claims.statement: Tedros publicly advocates an intensified global response to antimicrobial resistance (AMR), framing it as a major threat to modern medicine and stressing equitable access for low- and middle-income countries.

citations.quote: The burden of treatment-resistant infections falls heaviest on LMICs

claims.statement: Tedros publicly endorsed the political declaration on AMR approved by all countries at the UN General Assembly in September 2024, which includes commitments such as reducing global deaths associated with drug-resistant bacteria by 10% by 2030 and ensuring at least 70% of antibiotics used in human health belong to the WHO Access group.

citations.quote: At the U.N. General Assembly in New York on Thursday, all countries approved a major new political declaration to radically scale up efforts to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR)

claims.statement: Tedros argues that AMR responses should center affected patients, citing statements from AMR survivors Ella and John at the UN meeting's opening and closing segments.

citations.quote: placing Ella, John and all those affected at the center of the response

claims.statement: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is Director-General of the World Health Organization and is Ethiopian.

citations.quote: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is an Ethiopian Director-General of the World Health Organization

works.title: WHO director general: A breakthrough global agreement on combatting antimicrobial resistance (STAT News op-ed)

contribution.text: Authored the op-ed under his own name advocating the AMR political declaration.

expertise.category: Global health policy and advocacy on antimicrobial resistance
expertise.originalWording: director-general of the World Health Organization writing on AMR
